title: Central Chart Visual Dynamics Remediation
admission: RCN-G3V operator visual feedback after merged WP3E: candlesticks too bland, overlay too plain and insufficiently covering candles, chart insufficiently dynamic
scope: preserve the merged WP3E reference-locked shell geometry and all non-chart presentation boundaries
increase synthetic candlestick body, wick, border and up/down contrast without changing source values
replace the approximate normalized SVG overlay mapping with Lightweight Charts timeToCoordinate and priceToCoordinate binding
construct a presentation-only outer OHLC envelope from exact synthetic bar high/low coordinates and an inner body ribbon from exact open/close body extremes
add derived high, midpoint, close-flow and low presentation traces from the same synthetic source bars
increase chart depth and local visual energy through bounded overlay fill, halo, flow and navigator treatment
retain deterministic synthetic fixture values and first-valid fixture mode
extend Playwright assurance to prove chart/overlay coordinate-box alignment, presentation-only marking, responsive behavior and preserved WP3E geometry
acceptance: the central chart is the clear visual focal point and is materially more dynamic than the merged WP3E candidate
candlesticks are visually stronger and no longer read as bland or generic
the coverage envelope visibly wraps the candle path and is bound to the exact chart coordinate system rather than an approximate independent coordinate system
1536x864 reference geometry remains within the existing WP3E tolerance
1920x1080, 1440x810 and 1280x720 remain usable with no horizontal overflow
SYNTHETIC FIXTURE, NON-EVIDENTIARY and AUTHORITY EFFECT NONE remain explicit
null/residual, inactive C2E and authority-denied scenarios remain explicit
no market/scientific semantic inference or mutation authority is introduced
RCN-G3V operator visual rereview remains mandatory after merge
forbidden: invented indicators, signals, probabilities, forecasts or outcomes
rollback: Revert WP3F-only FixtureChart, chart-dynamics stylesheet, import and assurance changes; retain merged WP3E reference-locked fixture capability.
